topics.topic: Conic Sections: Ellipse construction by auxiliary circles and focal points methods
learningObjectives: Define conics as loci of points with constant eccentricity
Construct an ellipse using the concentric circles (auxiliary circles) method
Construct an ellipse given major and minor axes using the focal points (trammel) method

topics.topic: Conic Sections: Parabola and Hyperbola construction and engineering applications
learningObjectives: Construct parabolas using the rectangular/envelope method and locus method (eccentricity e = 1)
Construct hyperbolas using the directrix-focus method (eccentricity e > 1)
Relate parabolic and hyperbolic profiles to bridge arches and cooling towers

topics.topic: Engineering Loci: Cycloid, Epicycloid, and Hypocycloid generation
learningObjectives: Plot the locus of a point on the circumference of a circle rolling along a straight line (cycloid)
Plot epicycloids and hypocycloids rolling outside and inside generating circles
Explain gear tooth profile applications of cycloidal curves

topics.topic: Engineering Loci: Involutes, Archimedean Spirals, and Linkage Mechanisms
learningObjectives: Construct the involute of a circle and regular polygons
Construct the Archimedean spiral for one and two complete convolutions
Plot loci of points on pin-jointed four-bar kinematic link mechanisms

topics.topic: Orthographic Projection: First-Angle projection of shaped machine components
learningObjectives: Understand the geometry of First-Angle projection (plan below front elevation)
Project front elevation, end elevation, and plan views from pictorial blocks
Represent hidden details and center lines in standard first-angle layout

topics.topic: Orthographic Projection: Third-Angle projection and projection symbol conventions
learningObjectives: Understand Third-Angle projection principles (plan above front elevation)
Draw ISO First-Angle and Third-Angle truncated cone projection symbols
Convert pictorial machine bracket drawings into complete 3-view Third-Angle projections

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Orthographic Projection Exam
learningObjectives: Assess pupil proficiency in conic loci and angle of projection layout
Evaluate dimensional accuracy and projection alignment across orthographic views
Provide remedial drafting exercises on missing view reconstruction

topics.topic: Sectional Views: Full section, half section, and cutting-plane lines
learningObjectives: Represent cutting planes using thick ends with directional arrows (A-A, B-B)
Apply standard 45° hatching rules for sectioned metal, wood, and concrete
Draw full-sectional and half-sectional views of hollow shafts and pulleys

topics.topic: Auxiliary Projections: True lengths of lines and true shapes of inclined surfaces
learningObjectives: Determine the true length and inclination angle of oblique lines using revolution
Project primary auxiliary views to reveal true shapes of truncated surfaces
Apply auxiliary planes to oblique solid pyramids and prisms

topics.topic: Isometric Projection of Curves and Circles: Four-center approximate method
learningObjectives: Construct isometric circles on top, front, and side isometric planes
Use the four-center approximate ellipse method with compasses
Draw isometric pictorial views of cylinders, bearing housings, and rounded brackets

topics.topic: Introduction to Architectural Drawing: Ground floor plans, symbols, and conventions
learningObjectives: Recognize standard architectural symbols for doors, windows, walls, and fittings
Draft a single-bedroom bungalow floor plan to scale 1:50 or 1:100
Dimension rooms, wall thicknesses, and window schedules according to building codes

topics.topic: Comprehensive Termly Technical Drawing Revision & Drafting Speed Clinic
learningObjectives: Review conics, orthographic projection, sectional views, and floor plans
Execute timed past WAEC Paper 2 practical drawing questions
Refine layout spacing, title block details, and drafting consistency

topics.topic: Terminal Examination and Board Practical Assessment
learningObjectives: Administer standardized SSS 2 Technical Drawing practical examination
Grade sheets according to national WAEC marking standards
Record marks for school broadsheet and academic records
